overview.about: The Venice Film Festival is the oldest film festival in the world, first held in 1932, and part of cinema's 'big three'. Staged each late summer on the Lido, its top prize is the Golden Lion, and in recent years it has become a launchpad for major awards-season contenders.
overview.nextEvent: The next Venice Film Festival runs in late August and early September on the Venice Lido. The international jury awards the Golden Lion, and the festival's glamorous premieres open the autumn awards season.
